dafeiyu.description: Slender 2D Japanese anime girl with long wavy royal-blue hair fading to sky-blue at tips, distinctive navy-and-white whale-fin side ears with a light-blue bow, bright sapphire-blue eyes, white frilly maid headband, fitted dark-navy and white maid dress with gold buttons, frilly white apron with a cute navy whale embroidery, large glossy blue whale tail emerging beneath a big white back bow, white thigh-high stockings with navy bows, and navy Mary Jane shoes. Crisp 2D cel-shaded anime proportions, slender build.

gemini_neko.description: Lively slender 2D Japanese anime cat-ear girl with long flowing periwinkle-blue to lavender-pink gradient wavy hair, tall fluffy lavender cat ears, iridescent four-point star hairpins, bright heterochromatic eyes (pink-magenta right eye and golden-yellow left eye), navy-and-lavender star-themed magical idol outfit with detached wide sleeves, midriff top, pleated navy-and-white skirt, fluffy blue-purple cat tail, white loose leg-warmer socks, and navy platform shoes. Crisp 2D cel-shaded anime style.

yowane_haku.description: Cool composed tall anime young woman with long glossy silver-white hair styled in a high side ponytail, sharp crimson-red eyes wearing sleek thin red-rimmed rectangular glasses, crisp white collared shirt under a tailored dark-navy blazer jacket, dark navy plaid pleated skirt, black thigh-high stockings, and black loafers. Calm deadpan intelligent expression, sharp anime proportions.
